QUESTIONS & GAPS

Questions, knowns and gaps

A question inventory that records what is known, what is answered, what is still missing, and the specific action that closes each gap.

Reading the inventory

A question is Answered only when the answer is supported by an official source that is linked in the row. Partially answered means the data exists but the conclusion does not. Open means the answer is not available from any source this project is permitted to use, and the action column names what would close it.
